kappa.label: kappa
kappa.role: odd central element; carries the inhomogeneous deformation [X,Y]_γ = [X,Y]_0 + κ γ(X,Y)

K.label: K
K.role: even central element (Bakalov–Sullivan); identified with 1, excluded from basis/PBW

inhomogeneous_deformation.description: Inhomogeneous (gb) deformation of C(n+1) obtained from the deformed mixed relation of the oscillator algebra
inhomogeneous_deformation.bracket_form: [X,Y]_γ = [X,Y]_0 + κ (γ(X,Y) + γ_K(X,Y) K), κ on the left

gb_matrix.parameter_type: scalar (even) coefficient; the deformation term κ·gb is odd

inhomogeneous_deformation.pair_coverage: all ordered pairs (X, Y); only non-zero coefficients listed
